tools.name: search_blog_articles
tools.description: Search forms.app's blog for articles, guides and how-tos by keyword. Returns matching article titles and summaries.

keyword.description: Search term, e.g. "how to create a survey".

tools.name: search_form_templates
tools.description: Search forms.app's library of ready-made form and survey templates by keyword. Returns matching templates with their names and descriptions so the user can pick one to start from.

keyword.description: Search term, e.g. "contact form", "job application", "customer survey".

tools.name: search_help_center
tools.description: Search the forms.app help center for support articles answering "how do I…" questions about using the product.
